title: Escort and Protect the convoy mission -Under Realm
author: angrylittledev
selftext:
Has anyone else noticed that Opus 4.7 has gotten a whole lot dumber recently? Like when it comes to fixing small issues and glitches it just keeps running in the loop causing the same or worse problems? When it comes to making a whole section or even a whole game from scratch it does a good job, but fixing issues is not its strong suit. I had to switch to 4.6 and constantly start new chats every few questions asked to fix the problems I had. Then I had to ask Gemini (which failed epically at fixing the code) then turned to GPT to see if it can help, while it did fix some issues, the fixes didn't apply across the board. Eventually I went back to the code from 10 days ago, before I made certain changes, and fixed some important mechanics like fish being aggressive, fish fleeing from you, how they attack you, how models face you.. For 7 days I fixing these 3-4 problems. I fully animated and rigged the fish models in blender also using 4.6 Opus.   
  
I have no fixed every glitch in the game (hopefully) and the game is now 100% glitch free and complete. 

This is my favorite type of side mission, protecting convoys, and this is the easy difficulty, on medium and hard it gets well, harder. Plus this is Zeus the 5 million credit end game ship. It's the best you can get in game, absolute beast in terms of speed and maneuverability.  Give it a try, and let me know if you find any glitches. 

[https://nerothearchangel.itch.io/underrealm](https://nerothearchangel.itch.io/underrealm)

comments.author: mistafisha
comments.body: Glitch and bug free you say? 🤣

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: Yeah for now, I tested all of the mechanics they all work as intended. Nothing breaks atm. All missions properly load and end. I had issues before where certain missions wouldn't register properly or display properly etc. Give it a try, if you find a bug or a glitch lemme know 😃

replies.author: angrylittledev
replies.body: It's not gas effect, those are water bubbles since it's in the ocean, but I'll look and see if I can find better ones.  There is music in the game when you join at the stations and in the main menu, plus when you're being attacked by the pirates. There's no ambient music while you're doing mission so you can hear radar warning you of the danger and also to give a sense of dread. Thank you for the input. I'll see about those bubble effects.
